_comment: Security headers for every page. Used by scripts/serve.mjs (local tests) and repeated in deploy/Caddyfile (tests/unit check they match). One policy for all pages: the site navigates without reloads, so the first page's policy applies to the whole visit, and Strudel needs eval, blob workers and https samples. script-src has data: because Strudel's effects (coarse, crush, shape, distort, supersaw…) are an AudioWorklet module bundled as a data: URL; without it those notes don't play. With 'unsafe-inline' already allowed, data: adds no new way in.
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https:; media-src 'self' https: blob: data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
